body: v0.1.0 and cli/v0.1.0 were published to the Go module proxy and then deleted from the repo. Deleting a tag does not withdraw it: both stay in the checksum database and stay installable, so re-tagging that version would give different code under the same version. Releases skip forward (0.1.1).
title: Deleted v0.1.0 tags are never reused
